run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-17T09:26:20Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend-proxy is backed by a real failure of the /api/data request path. Error spans on frontend-proxy's ingress and router frontend egress spans rose from a 0-4 per 5-minute background level to ~125-294 per 5-minute sample starting in the window ending 09:28:20Z, and its own logs show HTTP 500 responses on /api/data (other routes 200). The proxy's 500s come from frontend: frontend's own GET /api/data, executing api route (pages) /api/data and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds spans are STATUS_CODE_ERROR at 226.67 (09:31:20 bucket) and 243.72 (09:36:20 bucket) with successes falling to 4.44 then 0, while the pre-incident baseline at 09:01 shows GetAds gRPC status 0 and HTTP 200. The dependency behind this call, the ad pod ad-554b849958-fcl25, is itself failing: its container was OOMKilled (exitCode 137) at 09:25:49Z and restarted at 09:25:50Z, its application logs stop at 09:25:46Z with no lines after the restart, and ad's own oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, getAdsByCategory and getRandomAds span counts drop to 0 at the 09:31:20 and 09:36:20 buckets. Failing GetAds calls are fast (214.98 of 243.72 calls in the last bucket complete in <=2ms), consistent with immediate connection failure rather than timeout, and the Service ad endpoints still list the pod (100.96.4.112), whose container has no readiness probe, so Kubernetes keeps it Ready. The only evidence for what injected the fault is Kubernetes events: Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-jvm-chaos has been spawning JVMChaos experiments every ~1 minute since 09:25:14Z, each of which reports 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-fcl25/ad' (last shown run otel-demo-ad-jvm-chaos-qttkp started 09:34:21Z). Because events are the only evidence for that cause, the conclusion is partial.

claims.text: frontend-proxy's own error spans jumped from background levels: ingress STATUS_CODE_ERROR went 2.74 (09:31:20 point of the earlier series) -> 1.11 -> 3.33 -> 2.22 -> 2.5 -> 1.11 -> 3.33, then 126.67, 231.11, 243.33, 293.75, 191.08 in the 5-minute increases, while ingress STATUS_CODE_UNSET stayed ~2800-3500 per 5 minutes.

frontend-proxy's router frontend egress span shows the same jump: STATUS_CODE_ERROR is 0 until the point at 09:26:20 (value 2.22 in the 5-minute window) then 124.44, 230, 243.33, 293.75 and 190.0, so the failures originate from the frontend upstream, not from the proxy's inbound side alone.

frontend-proxy container logs for pod frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-whhck contain HTTP 500 responses on GET /api/data (response size 21 bytes, e.g. 'GET /api/data HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream') while other endpoints such as /api/products, /api/cart, /api/recommendations and GET / return 200 in the same log stream.

Across services, the error-span increase is concentrated in frontend and frontend-proxy: frontend GET /api/data, executing api route (pages) /api/data and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds each go from 0 errors to 226.67 and 243.72 in the 5-minute buckets, while their success (STATUS_CODE_UNSET) counts fall from ~222-281 per 5 minutes to 4.44 and then 0.

The frontend failure is limited to its ad-dependent path: in the same window the error increases for frontend GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/cart and /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder are 0.

Pre-incident behavior on the same path was healthy: traces returned for ad between 09:01:22Z and 09:01:26Z show ad oteldemo.AdService/GetAds spans with rpc.grpc.status_code="0", frontend GET /api/data spans with http.status_code="200" and frontend-proxy ingress spans with http.status_code "200"/"308" and zero error rows.

The ad service stopped serving requests: its own span increases for oteldemo.AdService/GetAds (235.56), getAdsByCategory (207.78) and getRandomAds (72.22) in the bucket ending 09:26:20Z fall to 0 at the 09:31:20Z and 09:36:20Z buckets; ad logs from pod ad-554b849958-fcl25 stop at 09:25:46.817Z and a query for 09:26:00Z-09:31:30Z returned no ad log lines at all.

Pod ad-554b849958-fcl25's ad container was terminated at 2026-11-17T09:25:49Z with exitCode 137 and reason OOMKilled, restartCount is 1, and the current container started at 2026-11-17T09:25:50Z; the Deployment ad declares memory limit 450Mi and memory request 225Mi for the ad container.

The ad container has no readiness or liveness probe in the ad Deployment's container spec (env, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad, ports, resources only), the pod's Ready and ContainersReady conditions are True from 09:25:50Z, and the Service ad endpoints still list pod ad-554b849958-fcl25 at 100.96.4.112:8080, so traffic is still routed to a pod whose application emits no logs or spans.

Failing frontend grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds calls are fast rather than hanging: in the bucket ending 09:36:20Z, 214.98 of the 243.72 calls are in the <=2ms bucket and 241.59 in <=200ms, i.e. the calls fail almost immediately.

Chaos Mesh events show Schedule otel-demo-ad-jvm-chaos (namespace chaos-mesh) spawning JVMChaos experiment objects roughly every minute starting at 09:25:14Z (otel-demo-ad-jvm-chaos-4c7dg, -tdvvl, -7fjbx, -7zk5w, -t8tf2, -9jglq, -9626f, -t4jlc, -452d7, -qttkp), each reporting 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-fcl25/ad' followed later by TimeUp/Recovered.

The JVMChaos applications coincide with and continue through the ad outage: Applied at 09:25:24Z, 09:26:24Z, 09:27:29Z, 09:28:23Z, 09:29:20Z, 09:30:19Z, 09:31:32Z, 09:32:34Z and 09:33:30Z for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-fcl25/ad, while ad span counts are already 0 from the 09:31:20Z bucket and /api/data is 100% error at the 09:36:20Z bucket.

Pod ad-554b849958-fcl25 is owned by ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 (ownerReferences controller=true) and was not recreated: its start time is 2026-11-17T08:48:45Z and the only pod events in otel-demo and this window are Pulled/Created/Started for container ad at 09:25:49-09:25:50Z, i.e. a container restart, not a pod replacement.

A query for networkpolicies in namespace otel-demo returned zero objects (total_items_processed 0), so no NetworkPolicy object was present to explain refused connections between frontend and ad at the time of the query.

Other services' error-span series returned by the same aggregate query stayed at 0 across the window, e.g. checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, accounting orders receive, ad flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveBoolean and recommendation /flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream, so the failures are not cluster-wide.

The 09:25:49Z OOMKill and container restart alone do not explain the sustained outage: the ad container has been running since 09:25:50Z with restartCount 1, yet ad spans are 0 in the 09:26:20-09:31:20Z and 09:31:20-09:36:20Z buckets and frontend /api/data errors persist to 09:36:20Z.

The Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-jvm-chaos is the origin of the fault: it started spawning JVMChaos experiments against otel-demo/ad-554b849958-fcl25/ad at 09:25:14Z, ~35s before the ad container was OOMKilled, and it kept applying chaos to that same container every minute while the ad service produced no logs or spans and frontend's GetAds calls failed; the exact injected action cannot be read because JVMChaos resources are not queryable here.

The ad container's OOMKill may itself be a consequence of the JVM chaos injection into that JVM under a 450Mi memory limit, rather than an independent memory leak; this is unverified because neither the JVMChaos spec nor the killed container's previous logs are readable.

Treat the Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-jvm-chaos as the fault source to inspect and stop/verify (its JVMChaos spec, target and action), and separately add a real readiness probe to the ad container so a container that is running but not serving is removed from the Service ad endpoints instead of receiving traffic (add a readinessProbe on the container's port 8080 and re-check the 450Mi memory limit against the JVM heap).

gaps: The JVMChaos experiment objects and the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-jvm-chaos could not be read (their kinds are not permitted to this investigation), so the injected action (e.g. exception, latency, return), target selector and duration are unknown; only their Kubernetes events are evidence. The change_history integration is also not available.

No Jaeger traces exist for the failure window: traces_search for service frontend in 09:26:00Z-09:37:34Z returned nothing, traces_search_by_tags with error=true for frontend-proxy returned nothing, and ad traces only go up to 09:01:26Z, so the gRPC status code and error text of the failing GetAds calls are unverified.
frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-cmhqq application logs returned zero lines for 08:26:20Z-09:37:34Z, so no frontend-side exception text for the /api/data 500s was available.

The OOMKilled ad container's previous instance logs were unavailable (HTTP 400 'previous terminated container not found') and the restarted container wrote no log lines after 09:25:46Z, so it cannot be determined from logs whether the restarted JVM failed to start or was frozen by the continuing chaos injection.

The RequestErrorRate alerting rule was not found in Prometheus with rule_name or alertname filters (both returned nothing), so the alert's exact expression and denominator (annotation current 1.5333) could not be verified against the rule definition.

Pod fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-wbm7f shows restartCount 1 and one bucket showed a 1.11 error-span increase on its flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream span; neither is tied to the ad/frontend-proxy path by the evidence, so this change during the window is unplaced (not counted as impact).

The kube_replicaset_owner series for ad-554b849958 and the kube_deployment_status_replicas_available series for deployment ad returned no data, so the ReplicaSet-to-Deployment ownership edge and the deployment's replica status were not confirmed from metrics (ownership of the pod to ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 is confirmed from the pod object).
next_steps: Read the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-jvm-chaos and its spawned JVMChaos resources (spec.action, mode, selector, duration) with a permission set that allows chaos-mesh CRs, and confirm whether the experiment is still active.
Retrieve the killed ad container's previous logs (kubectl logs -p) and the restarted container's stdout directly, plus JVM heap/GC data, to determine why the restarted ad process serves no requests.
Fetch the firing RequestErrorRate rule definition from the alerting Prometheus to confirm which metric and threshold produced 1.5333 for service_name frontend-proxy.
Re-check whether Jaeger can return traces from after 09:26Z (its in-memory store appears to end earlier), or use the collector's span data for the failing GetAds status code.
